jobs_results.description:
We understand that the world we want tomorrow starts with how we do business today, and that's why we're inspired to make A Better World for Pets. Antech is comprised of a diverse team of individuals who are committed to each other's growth and development. Our culture is centered on our guiding philosophy, The Five Principles: Quality, Responsibility, Mutuality, Efficiency and Freedom. Current Associates will need to apply through the internal career site. Please log into Workday and click on Menu or View All Apps, select the Jobs Hub app, then click the magnifying glass to Browse Jobs.

The Target Pay Range for this position is $99,330 - $124,000 annually. At Antech, pay decisions are determined using factors such as relevant job-related skills, experience, education, training and budget.

Job Purpose/Overview

The Performance Marketing & Analytics Manager will serve as the primary owner of marketing analytics and performance measurement, transforming data into clear, actionable insights that drive stronger business performance. This role owns attribution, ROI measurement, customer journey analytics, and closed-loop reporting across Marketing, Sales, and Product.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities

Develop, maintain, and optimize marketing performance measurement frameworks to evaluate campaign effectiveness, pipeline contribution, lead generation, customer acquisition, and revenue impact.Build and manage marketing dashboards, scorecards, and executive reporting using business intelligence and visualization tools to provide actionable insights to marketing and business leaders.Analyze marketing campaign performance across digital, email, paid media, events, content marketing, and demand generation programs, identifying opportunities to improve conversion rates, engagement, and return on investment.Partner with Marketing, Sales, Revenue Operations, and Business leaders to define key performance indicators (KPIs), establish reporting requirements, and ensure alignment between marketing objectives and business outcomes.Own marketing reporting and analytics within Salesforce and HubSpot, including campaign tracking, lead attribution, funnel analysis, lifecycle reporting, opportunity influence, and pipeline performance measurement.Develop and maintain lead funnel reporting, tracking prospects from initial engagement through marketing-qualified leads (MQLs), marketing channels and programs.Ensure data integrity, consistency, and governance across Salesforce, HubSpot, marketing automation platforms, and reporting systems through regular audits and process improvements.Collaborate with Revenue Operations and Sales teams to improve CRM data quality, campaign tracking standards, lead routing processes, and reporting methodologies.Identify trends, patterns, and opportunities through advanced analysis of customer, campaign, web, and sales data, translating findings into actionable business recommendations.Conduct ad hoc analyses and deep-dive investigations to support business decisions, budget planning, forecasting, and strategic marketing initiatives.Utilize tools such as Power BI, Excel, Google Analytics, Salesforce, HubSpot, and other analytics platforms to automate reporting and improve visibility into marketing performance.Support annual planning processes by providing performance insights, forecasting models, benchmark data, and recommendations for marketing investment optimization.Present findings, recommendations, and performance insights to marketing leadership and cross-functional stakeholders in a clear, concise, and business-focused manner.Continuously evaluate emerging analytics technologies, measurement methodologies, and best practices to enhance reporting capabilities and decision-making effectiveness.Education and Experience

Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Business, Analytics, Statistics, or a related field, or equivalent combination of education and experience.3-5 years of experience in marketing analytics, performance marketing, revenue marketing, business intelligence, or a related analytical role.Experience developing marketing attribution models, performance measurement frameworks, and ROI reporting.Hands-on experience with Salesforce and HubSpot is required, including campaign tracking, lead lifecycle management, pipeline reporting, and marketing-to-sales performance analysis.Experience working with CRM systems, marketing automation platforms, web analytics tools, and business intelligence solutions.Demonstrated experience translating complex data into actionable business insights and recommendations.Knowledge, Skills and Abilities

Advanced analytical and problem-solving skills with expertise in KPI development, attribution modeling, forecasting, and performance measurement.Proficiency with Power BI, Google Analytics, Excel, and data visualization tools.Strong working knowledge of Salesforce and HubSpot, including reporting, dashboard creation, campaign performance analysis, lead management, and CRM data governance. Excellent communication, stakeholder management, and data storytelling skills.Travel

As required.

Antech is a leader in veterinary diagnostics, driven by our passion for innovation that delivers better animal health outcomes. Our products and services span 90+ reference laboratories around the globe; in-house diagnostic laboratory instruments and consumables, including rapid assay diagnostic products and digital cytology services; local and cloud-based data services; practice information management software and related software and support; veterinary imaging and technology; veterinary professional education and training; and board-certified specialist support services.

jobs_results.description:
Meta's Infrastructure organization is seeking a Manager to lead energy analytics strategy for our global data center portfolio. As power demand grows by an order of magnitude over the coming years, energy cost and usage become increasingly material drivers of Meta's financial performance. In this role, you will lead a growing, geographically distributed team of experienced analysts responsible for developing the forecasting models and analytical frameworks that inform capacity planning, budgeting, procurement strategy, and rate design across Meta's data center infrastructure. As the portfolio continues to scale, this role carries increased ownership: setting standards across the team, developing experienced individual contributors and emerging leads, and serving as a primary energy analytics partner to Infrastructure and Finance leadership. You will also build the systems that quantify the portfolio's exposure to energy price and volume volatility across markets. 
 

 

 

 Manager, Energy Analytics Responsibilities: 

 
  Lead and grow a team of energy analysts spanning data center portfolio analytics, clean and renewable projects, cost and rate analysis, and load and generation forecasting. Own hiring, onboarding, capacity planning, and team structure as the function scales
  Develop ICs and emerging team leads
  establish career pathways, calibration practices, and succession depth so the team's analytical capability is not concentrated in any single person
  Lead with accountability, transparency, and recognition, promoting continuous improvement and learning across the team
  Serve as an expert on energy rates and energy usage for Meta's growing global portfolio of data centers
  Own development and continuous improvement of models to forecast energy usage, generation, and cost, and to analyze electric rate impacts for current and future data center sites
  Set and enforce analytical standards across the team, covering methodology review, model documentation, version control, assumption governance, and QA of outputs used in financial and capacity decisions
  Support analysis and strategy for development of new rate structures for current and future data center locations, including in new and emerging markets
  Strengthen how the team characterizes uncertainty in its forecasts, moving beyond single point estimates toward ranges and scenario views that reflect price and volume variability, historical forecast error, and concentration by market, technology, and contract type
  Help establish and scale an energy risk quantification capability within Energy Operations, building the systems that measure Meta's exposure to energy price and volume volatility and partnering with Finance to define the analytics and reporting cadence that surface material exposure shifts early
  Build standardized tooling, data pipelines, and reporting that scale with the portfolio, reducing manual effort and streamlining communication of data and impact to the broader organization and leadership team
  Consolidate fragmented energy data across utility, market, and internal backend sources into durable, queryable data products with clear ownership
  Own the data controls and escalation paths that keep utility and market data reliable as transaction volume increases
  Lead development and delivery of monthly and annual summaries of key energy metrics to the Global Energy team, Infrastructure partners, Finance, and senior leadership
  Build strong partnerships with Infrastructure stakeholders to track data center design and capacity engineering trends, improve load forecasting methodologies, and support energy efficiency efforts
  provide energy expertise to diverse internal teams and coordinate on relevant issues and requirements
  Represent energy analytics in cross-functional planning forums, translating analytical findings into clear recommendations and trade-offs for non-specialist audiences
  Refine processes, planning cycles, and reviews to support decision making, prioritization, and tracking of progress across key stakeholders
  Travel domestically and internationally as needed (up to 30%)
 
 

 

 

 Minimum Qualifications:

 
  8+ years of relevant work experience with an electric utility, financial institution, energy supplier, renewable energy project developer, or energy-intensive consumer
  4+ years of direct people management experience, including managing a team through growth and change
  Hands-on experience analyzing and interpreting energy usage data, electric tariffs, and wholesale energy market data
  Experience owning forecasting or analytical models used in budgeting, capacity, or investment decisions
  Experience building or materially scaling an analytical capability rather than inheriting an established one
  Advanced Excel skills and experience working with large data sets
  Communication and data visualization skills
  experience developing narratives and communicating effectively with multiple stakeholders and leadership
  Experience training, mentoring, and leading analytics professionals, and experience developing team members at different points in their career
  Background establishing programmatic approaches to work, supporting teams, and developing cross-functional relationships
  Experience prioritizing across competing stakeholder demands and communicating trade-offs
 
 

 

 

 Preferred Qualifications:

 
  Experience with energy or commodity risk quantification: exposure measurement, probabilistic forecasting, scenario and stress analysis, or risk reporting
  Demonstrated ability to integrate AI tools to optimize/redesign workflows and drive measurable impact (e.g., efficiency gains, quality improvements)
  Experience adhering to and implementing responsible, ethical AI practices (e.g., risk assessment, bias mitigation, quality and accuracy reviews)
  Demonstrated ongoing AI skill development (e.g., prompt/context engineering, agent orchestration) and staying current with emerging AI technologies
  Experience with Tableau or other data visualization software
  Experience overseeing a large energy portfolio including budgeting, forecasting, and data automation
  Experience managing a distributed or multi-site team, or managing managers/team leads
  Experience integrating AI tooling to redesign analytical workflows with measurable impact, including prompt and context engineering or agent orchestration, and developing models that bridge fragmented energy data across backend databases
  Experience with SQL and working directly with data warehouses or backend databases
  Experience with renewable energy procurement, PPAs, or clean energy project analytics
  Experience supporting large-scale infrastructure or data center growth
  Experience in international energy markets or regulatory environments
  Experience with Python programming
 
 

 

 

 About Meta:

jobs_results.description:
Manager, Data Science & Advanced Analytics – Stamford CT (Hybrid - 3 days In-Office)


Be a part of a revolutionary change!


At Philip Morris International (PMI), we’ve chosen to do something incredible. We’re totally transforming our business and building our future on one clear purpose – to deliver a smoke-free future.


With huge change, comes huge opportunity. So, if you join us, you’ll enjoy the freedom to dream up and deliver better, brighter solutions and the space to move your career forward in endlessly different directions. Our success depends on people who are committed to our purpose and have an appetite for progress.


Our beautiful HQ in Stamford, CT is just steps away from the Stamford Metro-North Train Station and easily accessible from NYC.


Your ‘day to day’:  



Workplace Model (Add to top of posting): Hybrid - 3 days in-office (Stamford, CT HQ) / 2 days remote per week.
Build, scale and maintain predictive models and analytics workflows using Python/R/SQL and modern cloud platforms (Databricks/Snowflake).
Design cost-effective, scalable data transformation pipelines with a strong focus on optimizing compute resources, query execution and data egress.
Transalate statistical models and data science discoveries into actionable insights for commercial and operational stakeholders via Power BI/Visualization tools.

Partner with stakeholders to support analytics initiatives that align to key business priorities across commercial, sales, and operations functions.


Ensure data accuracy and consistency by applying best practices in data validation and transformation.


Translate analytical findings into clear, business-friendly insights and recommendations.


Collaborate cross-functionally with business teams, data engineers, and senior analytics leaders to support decision-making.


Who we’re looking for: 


Legally authorized to work in the U.S.


Commutable distance to Stamford, CT.


Bachelor’s degree in Data Science, Statistics, Computer Science, Business Analytics, or a related field (Master’s preferred).



6+ years in quantitative analytics oe data science roles (FMCG/CPG or retail experience preferred).
Hands on proficiency in Python or R, advanced SQL and enterprise data warehouse/lakehouses (Snowflake, Databricks).
Demonstrated understanding of data platform efficiency, compute clustering and best practices in cloud resource optimization.

Hands-on experience with BI tools such as Power BI or Tableau.


Familiarity with structured datasets (e.g., sales, customer, or syndicated data) and common analytics use cases.


Strong problem-solving skills and ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.


Effective communication skills, with the ability to present insights to non-technical stakeholders.


Annual Base Salary Range: $132,000 - $189,750


What we offer: 


We offer a competitive base salary, annual bonus (applicable based on level of position), great medical, dental and vision coverage, 401k with a generous company match, incredible wellness benefits, commuter benefits, pet insurance, generous PTO, and much more!


We have implemented Smart Work, a hybrid model of working that promotes flexibility in the workplace.


Seize the freedom to define your future and ours. We’ll empower you to take risks, experiment and explore.


Be part of an inclusive, diverse culture where everyone’s contribution is respected; Collaborate with some of the world’s best people and feel like you belong.


Pursue your ambitions and develop your skills with a global business – our staggering size and scale provides endless opportunities to progress.


Take pride in delivering our promise to society: To improve the lives of millions of smokers.


PMI is an Equal Opportunity Employer.


PMI is headquartered in Stamford, Conn., and its U.S. affiliates have more than 3,000 employees.


PMI has been an entirely separate company from Altria and Philip Morris USA since 2008. PMI’s affiliates first entered the U.S. market following the company’s acquisition of Swedish Match in late 2022.


Philip Morris International and its U.S. affiliates are working to deliver a smoke-free future. Since 2008, PMI has invested $12.5 billion globally to develop, scientifically substantiate and commercialize innovative smoke-free products for adults who would otherwise continue to smoke with the goal of transitioning legal-age consumers who smoke to better alternatives. In 2022, PMI acquired Swedish Match – a leader in oral nicotine delivery – creating a global smoke-free champion led by the IQOS and ZYN brands. The U.S. Food and Drug Administration has authorized versions of PMI’s IQOS electronically heated tobacco devices and Swedish Match’s General snus as Modified Risk Tobacco Products and renewal applications for these products are presently pending before the FDA. For more information, please visit www.pmi.com/us and www.pmiscience.com.

The Workforce Strategy & Analytics team is looking for a Senior Manager to lead Customer Service & Operations (CSO) Demand Forecasting & Analytics. 



The Senior Manager is responsible for identifying, shaping, and delivering strategic outcomes for the CSO organization through a variety of business analytics disciplines. This individual will collaborate closely with business leaders, serving as a thought partner and driving organizational decision making by leveraging data and analytical insights across multiple areas of the business. 



This role specifically supports CSO, and the individual will consistently participate in strategic discussions with the Client leadership team, using their influence to help direct the organization’s strategy and address its most complex and high-priority challenges. An ideal candidate will be adept at making analytically sound decisions, even when information is limited, ensuring that solutions align with business priorities and support the overall goals of the organization. 



This is a fully remote opportunity for candidates in select geographies. Candidates who reside within 50 miles of the following locations will be required to perform onsite 3 days per week: Bloomfield, CT; Chattanooga, TN; Denver, CO; Scottsdale, AZ.; St. Louis, MO.



Position Summary

Responsible for providing strategy and analytics support for the Customer Service Operations team responsible for delivering customer service support across Medical, Dental, Digital, Chat and Pharmacy Benefit Services (PBS). Lead a team of business analysts and resource planning professionals, working closely with Operations, Workforce Management, Product and Technology teams to guide the development of analytical models/insights and build compelling business cases that positively influence the outcomes of the opportunities at hand. Maintain, improve and publish call volume, case volume and average handle time forecasts across multiple lines of business. Work closely with upstream and downstream Business, Finance and Operations partners to identify and size new pieces of intent and ensure these are accurately and timely captured to enable staffing strategies that optimize for both member experience and operational expenses. Act as a key thought partner for both the executive they support and their direct reports

Primary Components

Leadership:  Recruit and sustain a high performing analytics team capable of providing exceptional analytics and strategic insights to their primary executive partner organizations in CSO. Individual will set an exceptionally high bar for excellence, coach current associates to their full potential and recruit / develop high potential talent into open roles. Individual will create a collaborative culture that has a high degree of ownership for their work product while providing exceptional support for their partner/customer organization in CSO.Strategy:  Using a background of proven business acumen, make analytically grounded strategic recommendations to key stakeholders across Operations, Workforce Management including Footprint, Product and Tech. The individual will think far beyond “tomorrow” to identify transformational opportunities for change. The individual will partner with the C&CE Strategy & Analytics team on our mid to long-term Data Strategy in the context of the strategic transformation that will enable the Workforce of the Future. The individual will lead and/or support several strategic efforts such as Tech investments and deployment of AI capabilities in the C&CE ecosystem.Predictive modeling:  Maintain and improve forecast models by assessing new data elements, new drivers and modeling techniques, back-testing and validating the accuracy of these models.Analytics:  Employ a range of analytical techniques to assess the impact of new intent (e.g. new clients, new products, new technology, OPEX initiatives), identify business opportunities and make strategic recommendations. The individual will identify the right series of analytics approaches for each individual situation, understand the strengths and weaknesses of the analysis or model, and effectively incorporate those into the overall recommendation. The individual will also look to influence the identification, testing and deployment of new intent. This may include supporting the development of business cases, providing guidance on test design and analytics as well as making recommendations on deployment timing and associated staffing strategy, balancing risk vs. rewards. Execution:  Publish call volume, chat volume and average handle time long-range and short-range forecasts across US Employer (USE) and PBS lines of business.  The individual will also monitor and analyze forecast variance for these LOBs, digging into drivers and assessing/monitoring the impact of new intent.

Preferred Qualifications 

MBA or other relevant graduate degree in Math, Economics, Statistics, or Engineering 2+ years of people leadership experience Eight or more years of relevant analytics or management consulting experience Relevant healthcare experience Relevant experience in Operations and/or Customer Experience roles Four or more years of end-to-end model design and ownership experience, e.g. optimization, predictive analysis, or financial / credit modeling
